summary: Recent updates across GenAI, RPA, and development ecosystems highlight a shift toward more efficient, secure, and integrated AI solutions. Google’s Gemini API and app enhancements expand tool access and device compatibility, while UiPath introduces tokenless automation and rule‑engine governance to boost agent reliability. Automation Anywhere’s trusted‑AI framework and vendor‑onboarding software demonstrate enterprise‑scale AI governance, and Python’s 3.16 preview signals upcoming language improvements. Power Platform’s modern attachments control adds a new user‑experience layer for file handling.
